scope: Controlled sequential retrieval/ranking latency only: Vector vs Hybrid RRF vs Hybrid RRF + fixed Reranker. No LLM generation, concurrency, throughput testing, or tuning.

method_identity.hybrid_reranker: same Hybrid RRF candidates -> fixed CrossEncoder -> ranked results
method_identity.shared_candidate_rule: Within every query/pass, Hybrid and Hybrid + Reranker share the exact same RRF candidate objects and ranking.

measurement_policy.query_order: fixed W7-T3 heldout query order in every pass
measurement_policy.timing_boundary: Starts immediately before each retrieval/rerank component call and stops immediately after it returns. Metric computation, result validation, JSON serialization, file I/O, and LLM work are outside the timed interval. Hybrid + Reranker total is the sum of its shared Hybrid stage and rerank stage.
measurement_policy.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n - 1) * percentile over sorted samples

cold_start.interpretation: The first rerank call includes lazy model loading, tokenizer/framework initialization, and first inference; it is not a pure model-load-only measurement and is excluded from warm aggregates. Cold stages ran in the recorded fixed order, so their values are initialization diagnostics and are not a fair cross-method cold latency comparison.

claim_boundary: These measurements characterize the current local environment, not a production SLA.
Concurrency, throughput, saturation, and multi-worker behavior were not evaluated.
LLM generation and end-to-end RAG answer latency were not measured.
The five-query heldout quality set and local sequential workload limit generalization.
No ranking parameter, model, batch behavior, corpus, or index was changed.
